hazards.description: The long, straight stretch of roadway lacks any marked midblock crossings or traffic calming, which may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Implement high-visibility marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Add speed humps or cushions to slow down traffic in this residential area.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a small planting strip or furniture zone to separate the walking path from the roadway and provide a designated space for trash collection.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a vertical buffer, improve the microclimate, and naturally encourage slower driving speeds through psychological narrowing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide a 3-7 second head start for pedestrians before vehicles receive a green light.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and signage to designate a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and alert drivers to crossing locations.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement speed cushions or other vertical traffic calming measures to manage vehicle speeds in this residential environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Leveling
interventions.description: Repair or replace uneven concrete slabs to ensure a smooth, trip-free surface for all users.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street trees between the curb and the sidewalk to provide a physical and psychological buffer from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Introduce speed humps or speed cushions to manage vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Clear Zones
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk and designate specific zones for utilities and trash collection to maintain a clear pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Infrastructure
interventions.description: Installing street trees or planters would provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles while improving the residential character.

interventions.title: Trash Management Solutions
interventions.description: Implementing designated off-sidewalk storage for waste bins to ensure the clear walking path is maintained at all times.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near potential crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while encouraging slower driving speeds.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Enforcement
interventions.description: Implement and enforce regulations to keep sidewalks clear of trash bins and debris to maintain a continuous accessible path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Infrastructure
interventions.description: If this is a transit stop, install high-visibility marked crosswalks and appropriate signage to facilitate safe boarding and alighting.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a vegetated buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation from vehicles and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to encourage slower vehicle speeds on this residential block.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and shorten the crossing distance across the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a marked midblock crossing with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage to provide a designated safe point for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Add vertical traffic calming elements to reduce vehicle speeds on this straight residential collector street.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Adding street trees or planters in the furniture zone would provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian volumes are high, a marked mid-block crossing with signage would improve safety for those crossing between intersections.
